name: Process analysers (gas chromatographs, laser spectroscopy)
applications: oxygen and combustibles on flares and vessels
principle: Gas chromatography separates a vaporised sample in a column and a detector quantifies each compound. Tunable diode laser spectroscopy tunes a laser across one absorption line and applies the Beer-Lambert law to give concentration.

process_steps.name: Separation in a column or absorption measurement across a laser line
Concentration sent to the control system
